messages:
riley: Heads-up — alex is starting on-call shadowing next week. need to lock down who’s primary/secondary for the Wed night handoff (21:00 UTC) and confirm a pairing plan. cc @jamie for runbook pointers and @sam for escalation cadence.

alex: Thanks! I’ll be shadowing Wed 21:00–02:00 UTC. I’ve read the quickstart but would like a scripted checklist to follow during the first paged alert.

jamie: I can take primary for the 21:00–23:00 window and pair with alex. sam, can you be secondary 23:00–02:00? I’ll hand off 23:00 at the usual marker.

sam: Yep I can be secondary. quick note: I’m on-call for infra change freeze Fri so avoid scheduling long shadow shifts that go into Friday morning.

incident-bot: [automated message] scheduled paging test for eng-oncall at 22:15 UTC on 2026-03-18. Please ack within 5m.

morgan: Small coverage gap on Tues night between 02:00–05:00 UTC next week (holiday swaps). If alex wants extra night exposure we should avoid that slot. Otherwise we’re good.

riley: Good catch morgan — we’ll keep alex to Wed. Planning for the session: jamie will drive the first alert exercise (read-only for alex), then alex will try to triage a low-sev synthetic page with jamie supervising, then we’ll run a deliberate failover replay.

riley: Here’s the onboarding checklist I wrote last quarter — follow in order:
1) Confirm Slack paging + mobile push enabled (settings: /settings/oncall -> pagerduty webhook)
2) Shadow ack/initial triage within 5 minutes
3) Identify service and customer impact in 2 minutes
4) If unsure, escalate to secondary after 10 minutes
5) Run quick mitigation from runbook (link below) or fallback to circuit-breaker route

riley: Runbooks — please read these sections before Wed:
- https://wiki.redwood.ai/runbooks/oncall-index (start)
- https://wiki.redwood.ai/runbooks/serving-latency (playbook: triage -> mitigation -> rollback)
- https://wiki.redwood.ai/runbooks/critical-paging (escalation matrix)

jamie: Quick commands for the session (copy into your notes, alex):
```
# show recent error rate for serving-prod
curl -s "${METRICS_URL}/query?query=err_rate{service="serving-prod"}" | jq .
# trigger noop failover (test infra only)
./ops/failover --service serving-prod --dry-run
# view current routing rules
kubectl -n serving get configmap routing -o yaml
```

alex: Got it. can i get the exact link to the shadow checklist? and is there a minimal set of permissions i need for my laptop?

jamie: Shadow checklist is the first doc in the runbooks index (link above). Permissions: you need read access to metrics/alerts and temporary assume-role for ops runner. riley — can you provision assume-role for alex for Wed 20:45 UTC?

riley: Yep, will add alex to the "oncall-shadow" role with a 6-hour TTL. I’ll post the invite and the TF snippet for assume-role in this thread before EOD Mon.

incident-bot: [automated message] paging test result: 22:15 UTC — acked by jamie at 22:16 UTC; alex did not ack (expected). test marked SUCCESS.

sam: For escalation cadence — if primary cannot mitigate within 10m, escalate to secondary; if secondary can’t mitigate within 20m, call SRE lead and open a Sev-2 incident. Use template: /incidents create --sev=2 --service=serving-prod --pager=oncall.

morgan: Also recommend alex watches a recorded replay of last month’s latency incident (13m triage, 7m mitigation). link: https://internal.redwood.ai/recordings/latency-2026-02-12. it shows common blindspots.

alex: Thanks everyone. One last ask — during the pair I’d like to do the ack+first triage step and then watch jamie do the rollback. is that ok?

jamie: Perfect. we’ll do: jamie = explain, alex = ack+initial triage, jamie = mitigation steps, alex = document the steps in the post-incident note.

riley: Logistics: meet in #eng-oncall-voice at 20:55 UTC. jamie will start the pairing runbook and mark the thread with the session tag `#oncall-shadowing`. I’ll DM alex the assume-role link and post the TF snippet here.

riley: TF snippet (to be applied by infra-auto):
```
resource "aws_iam_role" "oncall_shadow" {
  name = "oncall-shadow-${var.username}"
  assume_role_policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.shadow.json
  max_session_duration = 21600
}
```

alex: Received the role invite. i’m good to go for Wed. thanks for the plan and the runbook links.

jamie: See you Wed. quick note: if a real page comes in during the test window, we abort test and treat as real — no simulated actions on prod.

riley: All set. tagging this thread with: #oncall-shadowing #handoff #runbook. If anything changes ping me.

morgan: thumbs up :thumbsup:

sam: :rocket:
